description.value: Holds the ninth turn on the outer wall at the lower ring and has held it in five separate years, which is as close to a career as the rota permits. She was the survey's first informant on the tides and for eleven years its only one, and she is the reason there are four tide tables rather than one: she declined to correct hers against the table made forty kilometres up the coast, on the ground that it was right there and hers was right here. She sat for a photograph in 2299 and asked for a copy, which took four years to reach her.

formOfAddress: by name on the flats, by turn number on the wall
